scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm build:examples && pnpm --filter @docs/app build
scripts.test:docs-workflow: pnpm --filter @fluentic/i18n build && pnpm --filter @fluentic/i18n-compiler build && pnpm --filter @fluentic/i18n-cli build && node --test tests/docs-workflow.test.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @fluentic/i18n test && pnpm --filter @fluentic/i18n-web test && pnpm --filter @fluentic/i18n-compiler test && pnpm test:examples && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && pnpm test:bundles
scripts.test:next: pnpm --filter @fluentic/i18n-nextjs build && pnpm --filter @example/nextjs build:cookie && TEST_LANGUAGE_MODE=cookie node scripts/test-next.mjs && pnpm --filter @example/nextjs build:url && TEST_LANGUAGE_MODE=url node scripts/test-next.mjs
scripts.release: pnpm build:packages && changeset publish && node scripts/sync-prerelease-tag.mjs
